title: Employee Violations — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
A disciplinary offence recorded against the employee.

Violation records can be routed for approval. When they are, the reporting employee and work location are required, and on approval the deduction type is set from the violation type's tiers according to how many earlier offences of the same type fall within its repeat period. No deduction is taken in payroll at present.

fields.label: OrganizationUnitId
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Organization Unit master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The department where the offence happened.

Example. Warehouse Operations

Why it matters. Shown on the disciplinary report.

fields.label: WorkLocationId
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Work Location master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The work location where the offence happened.

Example. Warehouse — Shuwaikh

Why it matters. Required when the record is routed for approval.

fields.label: DisciplinaryTypeId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Violation Type master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The kind of offence.

Example. Late arrival

Why it matters. Earlier offences of the same type within its repeat period decide the escalation tier used on approval.
fields.adminHtml: Maintained under General Master Info → Violation Types.

fields.label: DisciplinaryDate
fields.html:
What it is. The date of the offence.

Example. 14 Sep 2026

Why it matters. The repeat period is counted back from this date.

fields.label: DisciplinaryTime
fields.html:
What it is. The time of the offence.

Example. 08:45

Why it matters. Recorded for reference; no calculation or report reads it at present.

fields.label: ReportedById
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from the employee list.
fields.html:
What it is. The employee who reported the offence.

Example. Khaled Al-Rashidi (1044)

Why it matters. Required when the record is routed for approval.

fields.label: Severity
fields.html:
What it is. How serious the offence is.

Example. Low

fields.label: DisciplinaryDeductionTypeId
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Violation Deduction Type master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The penalty applied.

Example. One day's pay

Why it matters. Set from the violation type's tiers on approval when the record is routed. Not deducted in payroll at present.

fields.label: WlSendToEmp
fields.html:
What it is. Whether the warning letter was sent to the employee.

Why it matters. Recorded for reference; no calculation or report reads it at present.

fields.label: WlRecvFromEmp
fields.html:
What it is. Whether the signed warning letter was received back from the employee.

Why it matters. Recorded for reference; no calculation or report reads it at present.

fields.label: Comments
fields.html: What it is. Free-text notes about this record.
